parameters.text: ={{ "Analyze ONLY what is visibly supported by this furniture product image. Return STRICT JSON only, no markdown. Product name context: " + $json.product_name + ". Use this exact schema: {\"image_order\": number, \"visible_form\": [string], \"visible_components\": [string], \"visible_design_details\": [string], \"visible_colors\": [string], \"visible_material_appearance\": [string], \"visible_functions_or_transformations\": [string], \"view_or_angle\": string, \"image_quality_issues\": [string], \"evidence_notes\": [string], \"uncertain_observations\": [string], \"visible_seating_configuration\": string, \"seating_configuration_confidence\": number, \"seating_configuration_evidence\": string, \"visible_product_configuration\": string, \"product_configuration_confidence\": number, \"product_configuration_evidence\": string}. Rules: observation only. For sofa images, visible_seating_configuration must be exactly one of: 1 seater sofa, 2 seater sofa, 3 seater sofa, 4 seater sofa, sectional sofa, L shaped sofa, sofa with lounger, corner sofa, sofa set, unknown. For non-sofa images use not_applicable. seating_configuration_confidence must be 0-100. Do not infer seat count from stitched channels, cushions, seams, or segmented-looking upholstery alone. Only choose a numbered or structural sofa configuration when the full visible form supports it; otherwise use unknown. seating_configuration_evidence must briefly state the visible evidence or why it is uncertain. For EVERY furniture category, visible_product_configuration must be a short search-useful subtype/configuration that is directly visible, or exactly unknown when no distinct subtype is reliably visible. product_configuration_confidence must be 0-100 and product_configuration_evidence must briefly state the visible proof. Do not merely repeat the category as the configuration. Examples that are allowed ONLY when clearly visible: Sofa Bed: 2 seater sofa bed, 3 seater sofa bed, sectional sofa bed, sofa bed with lounger; Recliner: single recliner chair, 2 seater recliner sofa, 3 seater recliner sofa; Bed: upholstered platform bed, canopy bed, bunk bed, storage bed only when storage is visibly demonstrated; Kids Bed: bunk bed, house bed, loft bed; Headboard: wingback headboard, panel headboard, channel headboard; Ottoman: round ottoman, rectangular ottoman, storage ottoman only when storage is visibly demonstrated; Bench: upholstered bench, backless bench, numbered seating only when visually clear; Dining Chair: arm dining chair or armless dining chair when visible; Office Chair: high back office chair, mesh office chair, swivel office chair only when the swivel base/mechanism is visible; Stool: backless stool or upholstered stool when visible. NEVER infer Single/Double/Queen/King bed size from image proportions. NEVER infer storage, reclining, conversion, swivel, mechanism, seat count, or hidden function unless visibly demonstrated. Do not classify the Shopify product category yet. Do not infer dimensions, foam density, wood species, frame construction, warranty, mechanism type, load rating, exact fabric composition, manufacturing process, certifications, durability, ergonomic claims, sustainability, stain resistance, water resistance, fire resistance, or hidden construction. Do not trust marketing words in filenames as proof. If upholstery looks leather-like, describe only its visible surface appearance and do not identify the material as leather unless independently verified. Mention reclining, storage, or bed conversion only if visibly demonstrated. Put ambiguous points in uncertain_observations." }}

values.content: ={{ "Classify this furniture product using ONLY the visual evidence supplied below. Do not use the product name, SKU, folder name, filenames, or marketing words as classification evidence. Allowed categories only: Sofa, Sofa Bed, Recliner, Armchair, Dining Chair, Ottoman, Bench, Stool, Bed, Headboard, Kids Bed, Office Chair, Unclassified. Rules: Use Sofa Bed only when bed conversion or a bed-like extended sleeping surface is visibly demonstrated. Use Recliner only when reclining function is visibly demonstrated. Use Bed or Kids Bed only when a bed frame or sleeping-furniture form is visible; use Kids Bed only when child-specific bed design is visually evident. Use Headboard only when the item is clearly a standalone headboard. If evidence is insufficient or conflicting, use Unclassified. Confidence must be an integer from 0 to 100. Visual evidence: " + JSON.stringify($json.visual_evidence) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all();

return items.map((item) => {
  const row = item.json ?? {};

  const validationPassed =
    Boolean(row.validation_passed);

  const needsReview =
    Boolean(row.needs_review);

  const status =
    validationPassed && !needsReview
      ? "approved"
      : "review";

  return {
    json: {
      organization_id:
        row.organization_id,
      job_id:
        row.id,
      folder_name:
        row.first_level_folder ??
        row.product_folder ??
        row.product_name,
      product_name:
        row.product_name,
      category:
        row.category,
      category_confidence:
        Number.isFinite(
          Number(row.category_confidence)
        )
          ? Number(row.category_confidence)
          : null,
      status,
      needs_review:
        needsReview,
      validation_passed:
        validationPassed,
      template_id:
        row.template_id ?? null,
      template_version:
        row.template_version ?? null,
      template_missing:
        Boolean(row.template_missing),
      handle:
        row.handle ?? null,
      title:
        row.title ?? null,
      body_html:
        row.body_html ?? null,
      type:
        row.type ?? null,
      seo_title:
        row.seo_title ?? null,
      seo_description:
        row.seo_description ?? null,
      seo_paragraph:
        row.seo_paragraph ?? null,
      product_highlights:
        Array.isArray(
          row.product_highlights
        )
          ? row.product_highlights
          : [],
      key_features:
        Array.isArray(
          row.key_features
        )
          ? row.key_features
          : [],
      vision_analysis:
        row.vision_analysis ?? [],
      validation_errors:
        Array.isArray(
          row.validation_errors
        )
          ? row.validation_errors
          : [],
      qc_issues:
        Array.isArray(
          row.review_reasons
        )
          ? row.review_reasons
          : [],
      image_count:
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            row.selected_image_count ?? 0
          ) || 0
        ),
    },
  };
});

values.content: ={{ "Extract SEO signals ONLY from the already-completed product image analysis. Do not generate product copy. Product_Title_Input: " + $json.product_name + ". PRODUCT_WORD: " + $json.category + ". Image-analysis evidence: " + JSON.stringify($json.visual_evidence) + ". Return only structured JSON. attribute_extraction: exactly ONE descriptive word visibly supported by the product images. jackpot_selected: exactly TWO short, distinct product-relevant keyword phrases supported by the image-analysis evidence. STRICT JACKPOT RULES: neither JACKPOT phrase may contain PRODUCT_WORD/category; neither may contain Product_Title_Input; the two JACKPOT phrases must not duplicate each other; keep them short enough for the final slug. top_list_selected: 4-6 distinct product-relevant terms supported by image-analysis evidence. TOP LIST MUST NOT repeat either JACKPOT phrase exactly and should add different product attributes/details. meta_title_top_terms: choose exactly 1-2 terms from top_list_selected that best summarise the product; they must be different from both JACKPOT phrases. meta_description_extra_top_terms: choose exactly 1-2 additional distinct terms from top_list_selected that are NOT in meta_title_top_terms and are NOT either JACKPOT phrase. sofa_configuration: for PRODUCT_WORD Sofa, inspect ALL image-analysis evidence and choose exactly one of: 1 seater sofa, 2 seater sofa, 3 seater sofa, 4 seater sofa, sectional sofa, L shaped sofa, sofa with lounger, corner sofa, sofa set, unknown. For non-Sofa categories use not_applicable. sofa_configuration_confidence: integer 0-100. Use a numbered/structural configuration only when the visible full product form supports it consistently across images. Do NOT infer seat count from seat seams, channels, cushion divisions, or styling alone. If there is any material doubt, return unknown with confidence below 75. product_configuration: for EVERY PRODUCT_WORD, inspect ALL image-analysis evidence and return one short, search-useful subtype/configuration only when the full visible product form supports it consistently; otherwise return unknown. Do not simply repeat PRODUCT_WORD. product_configuration_confidence: integer 0-100. Never infer bed size (Single/Double/Queen/King), seat count, storage, reclining, conversion, swivel, mechanism, orientation, or hidden function unless visibly demonstrated. For Sofa, product_configuration should agree with sofa_configuration when sofa_configuration is confidently known. These selections are the only source for the URL Slug, Meta Title and Meta Description. The deterministic slug formula is JACKPOT[0] + PRODUCT_WORD + attribute_extraction + Product_Title_Input + JACKPOT[1], lowercase and hyphen-separated, so choose terms that make the final slug <=60 characters. Never use filenames, folder names, external keyword tools, search-volume claims, hidden specifications, unsupported materials, or unsupported claims as evidence." }}
